namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**

 * @property Carbon|null $updated_at
 */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\DTO\ProductDTO;
use App\Http\Requests\StoreProductRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateProductRequest;
use App\Http\Resources\ProductResource;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Services\ProductService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ProductService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('viewAny', Product::class);

        $products = $this->service->paginate($request->query());

        return ProductResource::collection($products);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(StoreProductRequest $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('create', Product::class);

        $dto = ProductDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $product = $this->service->create($dto);

        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(Product $product)
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $product);

        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(UpdateProductRequest $request, Product $product)
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $product);

        $dto = ProductDTO::fromRequest($request);

        return new ProductResource($this->service->update($product, $dto));
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Product $product)
    {
        Gate::authorize('delete', $product);

        $this->service->delete($product);

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\DTO\ProductDTO;
use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;

class ProductService
{
    private const FILTERS = ['code', 'slug', 'title'];

    private const SORTS = ['code', 'slug', 'title', 'created_at', 'updated_at'];

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $query  filter[field]=value, sort=field,-field, page, per_page
     */
    public function paginate(array $query = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $builder = Product::query();

        foreach ((array) ($query['filter'] ?? []) as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, self::FILTERS, true)) {
                $builder->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        $sorts = array_filter(
            explode(',', is_string($query['sort'] ?? null) ? $query['sort'] : ''),
            fn (string $sort) => in_array(ltrim($sort, '-'), self::SORTS, true)
        );

        foreach ($sorts ?: ['-code'] as $sort) {
            $builder->orderBy(ltrim($sort, '-'), str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        }

        $perPage = is_numeric($query['per_page'] ?? null) ? min(max((int) $query['per_page'], 1), 100) : 15;

        return $builder->paginate($perPage, ['*'], 'page', max((int) ($query['page'] ?? 1), 1))->withQueryString();
    }

    public function create(ProductDTO $dto): Product
    {
        return Product::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Product
    {
        return Product::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Product $product, ProductDTO $dto): Product
    {
        $product->update($dto->toArray());

        return $product->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Product $product): bool
    {
        return $product->delete();
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreProductRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateProductRequest;

readonly class ProductDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $code = null,
        public ?string $slug = null,
        public ?string $title = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreProductRequest|UpdateProductRequest $request): self
    {
        $data = $request->validated();

        return new self(
            code: isset($data['code']) ? (string) $data['code'] : null,
            slug: isset($data['slug']) ? (string) $data['slug'] : null,
            title: isset($data['title']) ? (string) $data['title'] : null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class StoreProductRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('products')],
            'slug' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('products')],
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class UpdateProductRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'code' => ['sometimes', 'required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('products')->ignore($this->route('product'), 'code')],
            'slug' => ['sometimes', 'required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('products')->ignore($this->route('product'), 'code')],
            'title' => 'sometimes|required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProductControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_products(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/products?per_page=2');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(2, 'data')
            ->assertJsonPath('meta.total', 3);
    }

    public function test_can_filter_products(): void
    {
        $value = Product::factory()->count(3)->create()->first()->getRawOriginal('slug');

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/products?'.http_build_query(['filter' => ['slug' => $value]]));

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonPath('meta.total', Product::where('slug', $value)->count());
    }

    public function test_can_sort_products(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/products?sort=code');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.0.code', Product::query()->orderBy('code')->value('code'));
    }

    public function test_can_create_product(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'code' => 'test_code',
            'slug' => 'test_slug',
            'title' => 'test_title',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/products', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('products', [
            'code' => 'test_code',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['code' => $product->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'code' => 'test_code',
            'slug' => 'test_slug',
            'title' => 'test_title',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('products', [
            'code' => 'test_code',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_patch_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create()->fresh();

        $response = $this->patchJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}", ['slug' => 'test_slug']);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('products', ['code' => $product->getKey(), 'slug' => 'test_slug']);
        $this->assertSame(
            Arr::except($product->getAttributes(), ['slug', 'updated_at']),
            Arr::except($product->fresh()->getAttributes(), ['slug', 'updated_at'])
        );
    }

    public function test_can_delete_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('products', ['code' => $product->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_product_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/products', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\DTO\ProductDTO;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Services\ProductService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProductServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private ProductService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->service = new ProductService;
    }

    public function test_can_paginate_products(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(5)->create();

        $result = $this->service->paginate(['per_page' => 2]);

        $this->assertSame(5, $result->total());
        $this->assertCount(2, $result->items());
    }

    public function test_can_filter_products(): void
    {
        $value = Product::factory()->count(3)->create()->first()->getRawOriginal('slug');

        $result = $this->service->paginate(['filter' => ['slug' => $value]]);

        $this->assertSame(Product::where('slug', $value)->count(), $result->total());
    }

    public function test_can_create_product(): void
    {
        $dto = new ProductDTO(
            code: 'test_code',
            slug: 'test_slug',
            title: 'test_title',
        );

        $product = $this->service->create($dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Product::class, $product);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('products', 1);
    }

    public function test_can_find_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $found = $this->service->find($product->getKey());

        $this->assertEquals($product->getKey(), $found->getKey());
    }

    public function test_can_update_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();
        $dto = new ProductDTO(
            code: 'test_code',
            slug: 'test_slug',
            title: 'test_title',
        );

        $updated = $this->service->update($product, $dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Product::class, $updated);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $result = $this->service->delete($product);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('products', 0);
    }
}
